finding_info.title: Defender for Endpoint - AMSI and Antivirus blocked credential-theft tooling
finding_info.desc: AMSI scanned the in-memory contents of powershell.exe on ws-fin-042.contoso.corp and identified the script as Backdoor:PowerShell/Bovter.A. Defender Antivirus quarantined the process while executing, and the host subsequently exhibited LSASS access attempts via rundll32.exe loading diag.dll — a classic credential dumping pattern. MITRE ATT&CK: T1003.001 (LSASS Memory), T1059.001 (PowerShell), T1140 (Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information).
